principle: Equip each agent with common safe core plus least-privilege role-specific capabilities. External tools and trading repositories are non-authoritative; capital authority remains exclusively inside AURELIA's deterministic control plane. Freebuff account/API bridge sources are reference/sandbox only and cannot be used to evade upstream access restrictions.

tools: Chrome DevTools MCP (planned; local client setup required)

KimiK3.role: parallel analysis and adversarial engineering review

GoogleAgentSkills.role: security, cloud and multi-agent architecture review

PlaywrightCLI.role: browser, session, network, trace and E2E verification
tools: Chrome DevTools MCP (pinned candidate; local client setup required)

JEV.role: validation, evidence audit, workflow testing and regression review

AURELIA.authority: capital plane only; subject to deterministic controls

forbidden_for_external_agents: direct production deployment without release gate
connection_truth: A repository can package skills and configuration, but authenticated third-party accounts/connectors must be established in their own secure control planes.

hard_constraints: External repositories cannot grant capital authority.
External code cannot mutate LIVE_LOCK or FINAL_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.
External repositories cannot read or persist secrets.
External trading engines remain research/reference only.
Only the existing AURELIA capital plane can authorize capital movement.

required_invariants: research agents cannot authorize live capital
external repositories cannot authorize live capital
sub-agents receive explicit skills rather than assumed inheritance
